# kagent Non-UI Parity Checklist

Scope: backend/control-plane/runtime parity only, excluding dashboard/UI.

Status labels:
- `DONE` = implemented and verified in code/tests.
- `NOT DONE` = missing behavior or not yet proven in a live cluster.

## Hard parity table

| Capability | Status | Evidence | Gap to close |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kubernetes CRD surface (`AgentSpec`, `ModelConfig`, `ToolServer`) | DONE | `deploy/k8s/crds.yaml`, `contracts/*.schema.json`, `src/k8s-crd.js` | None for declared scope |
| CRD -> runtime contract translation | DONE | `src/k8s-crd.js` (`run::start`, router payload, MCP payload mapping) | None |
| Reconcile diff/idempotency | DONE | `src/k8s-reconciler.js`, `tests/reconcile-spine.test.js` | None |
| Event-driven reconcile loop (watch events) | DONE | `go-bridge/pkg/bridge/translator.go` -> `k8s-controller::handle_event`, `src/k8s-controller.js` | None |
| Dependency-triggered reconcile (provider/tool change re-reconciles agents) | DONE | `src/k8s-controller.js` (`reconcileResourceEvent` for `ModelConfig`/`ToolServer`) + `tests/e2e.test.js` | None |
| Finalizer semantics on delete | DONE | `src/k8s-controller.js` (`karness.iii/finalizer`, `run::cancel`) + tests | None |
| Status/conditions lifecycle | DONE | `src/k8s-controller.js` (`phase`, `conditions`, `observedGeneration`) | None |
| Durable status write via iii primitives | DONE | `workers/k8s-controller/src/worker.js` using `state::set/get` | None |
| Provider integration parity (routing + provider config) | DONE | `src/bridges/k8s-provider-discovery.js`, `provider-router` composition | None |
| Tool/MCP integration parity | DONE | `src/bridges/k8s-toolbridge.js`, `mcp` composition | None |
| Session index parity | DONE | `src/bridges/k8s-session-index.js`, `workers/k8s-session-index/src/worker.js` | None |
| Memory surface parity (pluggable) | DONE | `memoryAdapterPlan` + `memory_merge` (`session-corpus`/`session-tree`/`state`) | None |
| A2A send/get/cancel/stream/resubscribe behavior | DONE | `src/bridges/k8s-a2a-adapter.js` (`buildA2AOperationPayload`) + bridge tests | None |
| Native A2A reuse over reimplementation | DONE | `scripts/pull-a2a-workers.sh`, vendored `vendor/iii-hq-workers/{a2a,a2a-client,mcp-client}` | None |
| ACP fallback when native A2A absent | DONE | `workers/k8s-a2a-adapter/src/worker.js` runtime detection + routing | None |
| Kubernetes RBAC + deployment manifests | DONE | `deploy/k8s/rbac.yaml`, `deploy/k8s/bridge-deployment.yaml` | None |
| Go bridge resiliency (multi-watch + retry/backoff) | DONE | `go-bridge/cmd/karness-bridge/main.go` (`watchWithRetry`, plural watchers) | None |
| Local smoke script usability | DONE | `scripts/smoke-e2e.sh` preflight checks, image override knobs | None |
| Live cluster rollout of bridge image in this environment | DONE | Pushed bridge image to `ttl.sh`, rolled out with `BRIDGE_IMAGE=<ttl-image>` + `BRIDGE_IMAGE_PULL_POLICY=Always`, pod is `Ready` | None for current environment |
| End-to-end runtime proof (watch -> reconcile -> trigger chain in live cluster) | DONE | Smoke run with `USE_ENGINE_STUB=1` showed bridge watching CRDs and forwarding `k8s-controller::handle_event` payloads to `/bridge/trigger` (verified in stub logs) | For real-engine proof, deploy a live `iii-engine` service instead of stub |
| Dependency-miss handling under event ordering races | DONE | `src/k8s-controller.js` now degrades to `Ready=False (ReconcileFailed)` instead of throwing; covered by `tests/e2e.test.js` | None |
| Full kagent production parity (non-UI) under failure/load scenarios | NOT DONE | Unit/integration tests pass; live-cluster behavior not fully proven under failure injection | Add failure-injection tests, soak runs, and multi-tenant auth validation |

## Current verdict

- Core architecture and narrow-worker decomposition are in place.
- Most functional non-UI capabilities are implemented.
- **Not yet 100% parity** because failure/load hardening and multi-tenant production validation are still open.

## Immediate next checklist

1. Add failure-injection scenarios for bridge retries and controller status/finalizer paths.
2. Run soak tests for repeated CRD update/delete churn (watch stability + idempotency).
3. Validate multi-tenant/auth constraints for bridge-triggered paths.
4. Keep controller worker continuously registered against the live in-cluster `iii-engine` and rerun smoke to prove the full runtime chain without route flaps.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

workers=(
  harness
  turn-orchestrator
  provider-router
  provider-anthropic
  provider-openai
  models-catalog
  session-tree
  session-inbox
  skills
  mcp
  subagent
  policy-denylist
  llm-budget
  auth-credentials
)

extended_workers=(
  acp
  autoharness
  approval-gate
  hook-fanout
  iii-database
  storage
  sensor
  shell
)

for w in "${workers[@]}"; do
  echo "Installing worker: $w"
  iii worker add "$w"
done

cat <<'EOF'
Baseline workers installed.
Optional parity-hardening workers available on current main:
  - acp
  - autoharness
  - approval-gate
  - hook-fanout
  - iii-database
  - storage
  - sensor
  - shell
Next: register and run karness adapter workers:
  - k8s-crd
  - k8s-reconciler
  - k8s-controller
  - k8s-provider-discovery
  - k8s-toolbridge
  - k8s-session-index
  - k8s-a2a-adapter
EOF

if [[ "${INSTALL_EXTENDED_WORKERS:-0}" == "1" ]]; then
  for w in "${extended_workers[@]}"; do
    echo "Installing extended worker: $w"
    iii worker add "$w"
  done
fi

# karness composition dependencies
# These are existing iii-hq/workers you should install with `iii worker add`
# and configure in your iii runtime environment.

runtime:
  - harness
  - turn-orchestrator
  - provider-router
  - provider-anthropic
  - provider-openai
  - models-catalog

state:
  - session-tree
  - session-inbox

interop:
  - mcp
  - skills
  - subagent
  - shell-bash
  - shell-filesystem

policy:
  - policy-denylist
  - llm-budget
  - auth-credentials

# Present on current iii-hq/workers main and useful for parity hardening.
extendedRuntime:
  - acp
  - autoharness
  - approval-gate
  - hook-fanout
  - iii-database
  - storage
  - sensor
  - shell

# Seen in commit history snapshots and can be revived/cherry-picked if needed.
historicalOptional:
  - a2a
  - a2a-client
  - mcp-client
  - session-corpus
  - context-compaction
  - audit-log
  - auth-rbac
  - dlp-scrubber
  - document-extract
  - provider-cli

historicalPinnedRefs:
  a2aLineageRef: d42a41a3f6f2
  sourceRepo: https://github.com/iii-hq/workers.git
  pullScript: scripts/pull-a2a-workers.sh

karnessAdapters:
  - k8s-crd
  - k8s-reconciler
  - k8s-controller
  - k8s-provider-discovery
  - k8s-toolbridge
  - k8s-session-index
  - k8s-a2a-adapter # optional; enable only if A2A parity gap is detected

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: karness-bridge
  namespace: karness-system
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: karness-bridge
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: karness-bridge
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: karness-bridge
      containers:
        - name: bridge
          image: karness-bridge:dev
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          env:
            - name: K8S_CRD_GROUP_VERSION
              value: karness.iii/v1alpha1
            - name: K8S_CRD_PLURALS
              value: agentspecs,modelconfigs,toolservers
            - name: III_BRIDGE_URL
              value: http://iii-engine.karness-system.svc.cluster.local:3111

iii: v1
name: k8s-reconciler
language: node
deploy: image
manifest: package.json
description: Kubernetes desired-vs-actual action planner on iii primitives.

apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: agentspecs.karness.iii
spec:
  group: karness.iii
  scope: Namespaced
  names:
    plural: agentspecs
    singular: agentspec
    kind: AgentSpec
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      storage: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            apiVersion:
              type: string
            kind:
              type: string
            metadata:
              type: object
            spec:
              type: object
              required: [sessionId, providerRef, model, messages]
              properties:
                sessionId: { type: string }
                providerRef: { type: string }
                model: { type: string }
                systemPrompt: { type: string }
                maxTurns: { type: integer }
                memoryProfile: { type: string }
                a2aMode: { type: string }
                toolServerRefs:
                  type: array
                  items: { type: string }
                messages:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: object
                    required: [role, text]
                    properties:
                      role: { type: string }
                      text: { type: string }
---
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: modelconfigs.karness.iii
spec:
  group: karness.iii
  scope: Namespaced
  names:
    plural: modelconfigs
    singular: modelconfig
    kind: ModelConfig
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      storage: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            apiVersion:
              type: string
            kind:
              type: string
            metadata:
              type: object
            spec:
              type: object
              required: [provider, defaultModel]
              properties:
                provider: { type: string }
                defaultModel: { type: string }
                endpoint: { type: string }
                secretRef: { type: string }
                discoverModels: { type: boolean }
---
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: toolservers.karness.iii
spec:
  group: karness.iii
  scope: Namespaced
  names:
    plural: toolservers
    singular: toolserver
    kind: ToolServer
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      storage: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            apiVersion:
              type: string
            kind:
              type: string
            metadata:
              type: object
            spec:
              type: object
              required: [protocol, url]
              properties:
                protocol: { type: string }
                url: { type: string }
                headersSecretRef: { type: string }

apiVersion: karness.iii/v1alpha1
kind: ModelConfig
metadata:
  name: anthropic-main
  namespace: default
spec:
  provider: anthropic
  defaultModel: claude-sonnet-4-5
  endpoint: https://api.anthropic.com
  secretRef: anthropic-secret
  discoverModels: true
---
apiVersion: karness.iii/v1alpha1
kind: ToolServer
metadata:
  name: tools-main
  namespace: default
spec:
  protocol: mcp-http
  url: https://tools.example/mcp
  headersSecretRef: tools-secret
---
apiVersion: karness.iii/v1alpha1
kind: AgentSpec
metadata:
  name: demo-agent
  namespace: default
spec:
  sessionId: session-1
  providerRef: anthropic-main
  model: claude-sonnet-4-5
  systemPrompt: You are helpful
  maxTurns: 3
  memoryProfile: ephemeral
  a2aMode: passthrough
  toolServerRefs: [tools-main]
  messages:
    - role: user
      text: hello from karness smoke

worker_name: k8s-reconciler
default_http_method: POST

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: iii-engine-stub
  namespace: karness-system
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: iii-engine-stub
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: iii-engine-stub
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: echo
          image: ealen/echo-server:latest
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: iii-engine
  namespace: karness-system
spec:
  selector:
    app: iii-engine-stub
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 3111
      targetPort: 80

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: iii-engine
  namespace: karness-system
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: iii-engine
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: iii-engine
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: engine
          image: iiidev/iii:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          args: ["--use-default-config"]
          ports:
            - containerPort: 3111
              name: http
            - containerPort: 49134
              name: ws
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 3111
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 2
            failureThreshold: 12
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: iii-engine
  namespace: karness-system
spec:
  selector:
    app: iii-engine
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 3111
      targetPort: 3111
    - name: ws
      port: 49134
      targetPort: 49134
